# Neoversine

> We build AI systems that replace work.
> Operating systems for agents, inference economics that scale, and the architectural ownership to run them.

## About Neoversine
Neoversine is an Agent-Operating-System and vLLM Inference Economics company founded in January 2024 by Arka Probha Roy, based in Kolkata, India. Rather than building fragile AI wrappers with n8n or off-the-shelf SaaS, Neoversine engineers foundational agent substrates built on Hermes agent-OS and self-hosted vLLM inference infrastructure.

## Core Capabilities & Proof Metrics
- **+40% Lead Conversion**: Delivered through ARC Network CRM with real-time collaboration intelligence.
- **10x Research Speedup**: Custom RAG & Graph-Memory agent pipelines.
- **0.96 mAP50 on YOLO Detection**: D8alytics synthetic data pipeline generating 700 YOLO images in <1 hour with zero real images.
- **VRAM Reduction from 92GB to <10GB**: Sakana Fugu-inspired multi-agent orchestration and dynamic model offloading.
- **Open-Source MIT Control Deck**: Event-driven runtime monitoring surface for live agent steering.
